sloka: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धो ऽस्मि तेनेमां नेह मातरम् ।हन्मि तीव्रेण दण्डेन दण्डार्हां पापकारिणीम् ॥ २.१०६.९॥
transliteration: dharmabandhena baddho 'smi tenemāṁ neha mātaram ।hanmi tīvreṇa daṇḍena daṇḍārhāṁ pāpakāriṇīm ॥ 2.106.9॥

translations.english: I am bound by a bond of righteousness for which I am unble to slay my mother who deserves severe punishment for her sinful acts.
